summary: Feed s103_single to NDR is degraded: 98.6% of bytes are encrypted, exceeding the NDR's 90% tolerance. All other visibility checks (duplicates, VLANs, directionality, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Almost all traffic on this feed is TLS/encrypted (98.6% vs 90% tolerated) with no upstream decryption. The packet broker is forwarding encrypted payload as-is, so the NDR sees only headers.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for deep packet inspection, JA3, and threat detection. At 98.6% encrypted it is effectively blind - cannot analyze application content, detect C2, exfiltration, or lateral movement inside encrypted sessions.

recommended_fix.why: NDR needs cleartext payload to restore detection coverage. Decrypt via dedicated SSL visibility appliance or packet broker decryption capability and forward a decrypted copy (or selective decrypted flows) to the NDR, while retaining encrypted copy if required for compliance.
